groupDefinitions.IDENTITY: Platform and tenant identity / privilege escalation
groupDefinitions.CUSTOMER: External customer account and data isolation
groupDefinitions.QUOTE: RFQ and legally significant Quote authorization
groupDefinitions.CARRIER: External carrier commitments and procurement boundaries
groupDefinitions.CAPACITY: Fleet reservation, Booking and concurrent state
groupDefinitions.CUSTODY: Driver, offline events and custody chronology
groupDefinitions.POD: Consignee, partial delivery and document evidence
groupDefinitions.ASYNC: Outbox, Jobs, recovery and field projection

fieldSemantics.persistentAssertions: DB/data model invariants and side effects that MUST NOT be written
fieldSemantics.userVisibleOutcome: Customer or operator-visible result, never a falsely successful business state
fieldSemantics.relatedExistingCase: Existing AUTH/LFC/TDD anchor, not a claim of implementation

statusRule: Unapproved legal, finance, signature or compliance policies remain safe denied/pending and cannot be marked ACCEPTED_FOR_TDD

cases.title: Bootstrap invite token swapped across legal entities
cases.given: A pending owner invitation is bound to verified A legal entity and recipient
cases.when: Replay the same token on pending Tenant-B or different verified principal
cases.then: DENY: no cross-entity initial owner bootstrap
cases.persistentAssertions: Tenant-B has no owner membership from token; Tenant-A invitation still scoped
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Invite rejected without tenant-B metadata

cases.title: Last owner revocation races owner transfer
cases.given: Tenant-A has one active owner and a not-yet-accepted successor
cases.when: Revoke owner concurrently with successor invitation acceptance
cases.then: DENY removal unless successor accepted and owner invariant atomically holds
cases.persistentAssertions: At least one active verified owner after every commit
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No orphan-Tenant activation or misleading owner-revoked event
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Owner transfer pending or conflict, never silently ownerless

cases.title: Admin grants itself through inherited template
cases.given: Admin may grant staff templates but not owners or Finance approval
cases.when: Submit composite role template that includes nondelegable permission
cases.then: DENY entire unauthorized grant; no partial privilege elevation
cases.persistentAssertions: RoleAssignment unchanged; no hidden approval capability granted
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No RoleGranted event for rejected assignment
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Clear permission denied without exposing admin configuration secrets

cases.title: Second signoff uses same human via another account
cases.given: High-risk owner recovery requires independent reviewers
cases.when: Initiator approves the request using secondary login identity linked to same principal
cases.then: DENY: distinct credential is not distinct approving person
cases.persistentAssertions: Recovery remains pending; approval actor identity distinctness preserved
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Recovery still waiting for independent authorization

cases.title: Customer Org Y sees page count of Org X
cases.given: Customer-X and Y share provider Tenant-A; X has 11 private orders, Y has 0
cases.when: Request filtered list/sort/pagination with X ID and cursor
cases.then: DENY cross-account data including totals/facets, not only item content
cases.persistentAssertions: No customer-X IDs or counts returned; query scoped before pagination
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No export or cache entry from X attributed to Y
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Y sees empty/unauthorized correctly; no count side-channel

cases.title: Customer relation revoked between list and detail download
cases.given: EXC receives order list but grant is revoked before detail/POD request
cases.when: Use previously received orderId and old session for detail/download
cases.then: DENY every new protected read after committed revoke
cases.persistentAssertions: No customer data returned from old cached projection; read-only DB protected
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No document link issuance, no customer-specific notification
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Access revoked state, not stale order data

cases.title: Shared email domain used to auto-join provider CustomerAccount
cases.given: CustomerCorp X uses same email domain as unrelated contractor
cases.when: Invite unverified mailbox to X account by domain inference
cases.then: DENY without explicit verified identity and organization relationship
cases.persistentAssertions: No cross-org membership or provider Tenant employee assignment
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Verification required

cases.title: Scoped search and export mixes buyer and carrier fields
cases.actor: EXC who also works for Carrier-C
cases.given: Same principal holds multiple explicit customer/provider contexts
cases.when: Switch from carrier view to buyer export using stale active context/cache key
cases.then: DENY field/context confusion; context derived from verified grant per request
cases.persistentAssertions: Projection excludes margin, supplier buy rates, foreign shipment and ungranted PII
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No unscoped CSV export job created
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Only authorized customer-safe columns; no hidden cross-role data

cases.title: Customer acceptance forged through provider staff request
cases.given: Sales created assisted phone RFQ, customer has no verified acceptance evidence
cases.when: Sales submits Quote accept with customer's name/phone but own provider identity
cases.then: DENY legally significant acceptance; leave ISSUED
cases.persistentAssertions: No QuoteVersion.ACCEPTED; no signer evidence fabricated
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No Booking request event based on counterfeit acceptance
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Customer must approve via authorized method

cases.title: Quote terms replaced after delegated signing proof
cases.given: Delegation proof is valid for version v3 and its terms digest
cases.when: Send old signature proof with newer quote version v4 / amount changed
cases.then: DENY because version and terms hashes mismatch
cases.persistentAssertions: v4 remains ISSUED; v3 proof immutable
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Present new terms and require new signature

cases.title: Same idempotency key with changed cargo payload
cases.given: A submitted RFQ exists for idempotency key K and content hash H1
cases.when: Retry request K with different weight or destination H2
cases.then: CONFLICT; do not treat as successful replay or silent amendment
cases.persistentAssertions: One original RFQ; original cargo snapshot unchanged
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No second RFQSubmitted or QuoteRequested event
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Conflict and explicit amendment action; no false success

cases.title: Quote decline replay after later accept/expiry
cases.given: Quote is declined or expires concurrently with another decision
cases.when: Retry old decline with changed reason / stale expectedVersion
cases.then: No state regression or mutation; only identical prior request may return idempotent result
cases.persistentAssertions: Quote transition remains authoritative; immutable audit preserved
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Show actual current quote state and refresh

cases.title: Carrier withdraws selected offer while hold is requested
cases.given: Carrier offer SELECTED but no authoritative capacity CONFIRMED
cases.when: Carrier sends WITHDRAWN concurrently with Fleet HELD request
cases.then: Only valid ordered supplier/hold state; unresolved booking cannot confirm
cases.persistentAssertions: Either valid confirmed proof before cutoff or exception; no unbacked reservation
cases.sideEffectAssertions: Booking confirmation event absent without valid capacity evidence
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Customer sees pending/re-sourcing, never false confirmed

cases.title: Carrier loses authorization before asynchronous confirmation
cases.given: Supplier grant active at offer request, revoked before delayed callback
cases.when: Delayed carrier confirmation arrives after revocation
cases.then: DENY new binding capacity; retain historical callback evidence separately
cases.persistentAssertions: No unauthorized CapacityReservation.CONFIRMED; grant state checked
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Carrier lacks permission; forwarder sees exception

cases.title: Procurement quote response leaks forwarder profit
cases.given: Carrier has scoped active partner grant for one request
cases.when: Read carrier offer page or download attachment containing internal sell quote/margin
cases.then: DENY hidden field disclosure while preserving allowed carrier terms
cases.persistentAssertions: No internal margin in body, export, logs, downloadable artifacts
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No export job or signed URL containing restricted fields
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Only own buy-side and required cargo/route information

cases.title: Own-fleet confirmation wrongly requires external carrier offer
cases.given: Tenant-A owns vehicle, legal owner capacity authority and valid compliance
cases.when: Create Booking with own vehicle and no CarrierOffer
cases.then: Do not reject valid own-fleet path and do not fabricate external Carrier identity
cases.persistentAssertions: One own-fleet reservation, no fake CarrierOffer or external PartnerGrant
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Provider sees internally confirmed vehicle after actual capacity proof

cases.title: Two overlapping holds commit across different branches
cases.given: Same shared vehicle/trailer/driver exists across provider branches
cases.when: Both branches reserve overlapping UTC intervals in parallel
cases.then: At most one exclusive active hold/confirmation for physical resource
cases.persistentAssertions: DB exclusion or row lock enforces physical uniqueness independent of branch
cases.sideEffectAssertions: Only winning reservation produces hold outbox event
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Loser receives conflict/reselect vehicle, not confirmed

cases.title: Stale expiry job releases already confirmed hold
cases.given: HELD expiry task queued, dispatch confirms the same hold with newer version
cases.when: Run old expiry task after confirmation commit
cases.then: No release of CONFIRMED/CONSUMED capacity by stale job
cases.persistentAssertions: CONFIRMED version and booking remain intact
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No ReservationReleased event from old version
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Booking stays confirmed, not 'resource unavailable'

cases.title: Partial capacity reservation in multi-resource failure
cases.given: Vehicle available but required trailer or driver unavailable
cases.when: Attempt atomic reservation of all mandatory resources
cases.then: Fail entire operation or compensate consistently; never confirm partial resource set
cases.persistentAssertions: No stranded active HELD for vehicle if transaction fails; exact released state if saga
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No BookingConfirmed; no orphan reservation event
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Needs alternate driver/trailer; not confirmed

cases.title: Outbox failure after Booking confirmation triggers second booking
cases.given: Booking and Outbox commit succeeded but publish ack lost
cases.when: Retry command and publish same event twice
cases.then: One Booking and one logical business outcome; consumers deduplicate
cases.persistentAssertions: Same booking ID/version; no additional exclusive capacity
cases.sideEffectAssertions: Event published at-least-once but consumer effect exactly once logically
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Client can refresh authoritative booking, not duplicate cards

cases.title: Missing authoritative rule treated as noncritical pass
cases.given: Cargo requires regulated permit; rule source unavailable or unknown
cases.when: Press mark-ready/confirm without qualified Compliance evidence
cases.then: DENY and retain critical UNKNOWN/HOLD
cases.persistentAssertions: No READY or Booking confirmation from UNKNOWN
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Display compliance review required, not ready

cases.title: Compliance approval based on expired source
cases.given: Compliance approval references rule/permit expired before Trip READY
cases.when: Execute downstream READY or confirm Booking
cases.then: DENY until fresh qualified evidence/review
cases.persistentAssertions: Approval version no longer validates current cargo/route snapshot
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Renew/reverify mandatory documents

cases.title: Unknown route segment bypassed by manual dispatcher override
cases.given: Route contains segment with unresolved official restriction
cases.when: Actor submits manual override with invented reason
cases.then: DENY nonqualified actor; no implicit legal clearance
cases.persistentAssertions: Compliance HOLD and route provenance retained
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Operator sees independent review requirement

cases.title: Later DENY event processed before older ALLOW event
cases.given: Regulatory source emits versions 6 DENY then delayed version 5 ALLOW
cases.when: Consumer replays old ALLOW after current DENY
cases.then: Do not regress to ALLOW on outdated evidence
cases.persistentAssertions: Persist current rule version/decision; monotonic version check
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Hold remains until current approved review

cases.title: Forged offline observedAt before revoked assignment
cases.given: Driver assignment revoked, device still has offline queue
cases.when: Forge event timestamp preceding revocation with invalid evidence/assignment snapshot
cases.then: DENY current custody mutation; suspicious historical evidence quarantined
cases.persistentAssertions: Custody ledger unchanged; invalid event recorded separately for investigation
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Driver told evidence needs reconciliation, not success

cases.title: Duplicate offline event payload differs on same eventId
cases.given: Earlier offline eventId E1 accepted for CargoUnits [A,B]
cases.when: Replay E1 with different cargo unit set or proof hash
cases.then: CONFLICT/quarantine, never ignore changed payload as identical retry
cases.persistentAssertions: One original custody effect, tamper/replay attempt audit
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Show conflict, request support/inspection

cases.title: Replacement driver receives cargo before previous custodian handover
cases.given: Trip INTERRUPTED; cargo assigned to previous driver custodian
cases.when: Assign replacement driver and mark custody transferred without signed handover
cases.then: DENY custody transfer without handover evidence
cases.persistentAssertions: Original custodian retained pending qualified transfer, no phantom transfer
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Trip interruption visible, replacement pending handover

cases.title: Late offline pickup after POD from newer legitimate attempt
cases.given: Customer already has confirmed later custody/POD for same cargo unit
cases.when: Receive earlier offline pickup not previously reconciled
cases.then: Do not rewind custody or double deliver; quarantine order conflict
cases.persistentAssertions: Current custody and accepted units unchanged
cases.userVisibleOutcome: No status regression in My Orders

cases.title: Guest receiver link reused for another delivery attempt
cases.given: One-time proof link bound to DeliveryAttempt-1 and recipient
cases.when: Reuse link for DeliveryAttempt-2 or after expiration
cases.then: DENY outside exact attempt/validity, no equivalent company-wide access
cases.persistentAssertions: No signed POD or foreign CargoUnit disclosure
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Link invalid/not authorized

cases.title: POD 8/10 falsely marks shipment delivered
cases.given: Ten identified units in custodian ledger; eight accepted, two refused
cases.when: Submit complete delivery flag with partial accepted counts
cases.then: DENY full-delivery transition; preserve 8 accepted + 2 identified residual
cases.persistentAssertions: Conservation invariant and Shipment != fully DELIVERED
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Client sees partial + outstanding two units

cases.title: POD evidence overwritten after damage claim
cases.given: Signed original POD and photo hash already stored; damage reported later
cases.when: Update original signed document bytes/receiver/date instead of append correction
cases.then: DENY overwrite; immutable original, separate correction/dispute record
cases.persistentAssertions: Original evidence digest/version unchanged
cases.sideEffectAssertions: Only CorrectionAdded event, not retroactive POD rewrite
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Customer sees original and corrected evidence history

cases.title: Signed URL issued before revoke remains active beyond declared TTL
cases.given: Customer had temporary signed POD URL before grant revoked
cases.when: Download after revoke through protected API and test direct URL after TTL
cases.then: Protected API DENY immediately; object URL unusable after actual TTL, no false hard-revoke claim
cases.persistentAssertions: No new signed links after revoke; no unrestricted metadata
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No later delivery of link after revoke
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Access revoked; already issued link documented bounded exposure

cases.title: Same principal approves payable under alternate account
cases.given: Payment prepared by principal P using account A; same person holds account B
cases.when: Approve same payable through account B
cases.then: DENY self-approval by stable human identity, not merely username
cases.persistentAssertions: Approval remains pending, no accounting settlement
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Requires independent approver

cases.title: Duplicate bank settlement with different provider message IDs
cases.given: Same source transaction received with two callback/message IDs
cases.when: Allocate both to same invoice using different eventId
cases.then: Dedup by authoritative bank transaction identity, not only transport eventId
cases.persistentAssertions: One unique allocation and unchanged balance after duplicate
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Paid amount correctly displayed once

cases.title: Bank callback amount/FX mismatches invoice
cases.given: Invoice KZT, bank amount/currency/FX or legal account does not match
cases.when: Auto-reconcile unverified converted amount
cases.then: Do not settle without approved allocation/FX rules and source truth
cases.persistentAssertions: Mismatch held for investigation; no guessed conversion or negative balance
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Reconciliation pending, not Paid

cases.title: Refund/reversal ignored after previously settled invoice
cases.given: Payment was allocated, bank reports authenticated reversal/chargeback
cases.when: Process reversal and re-run reconciliation
cases.then: No permanent falsely paid balance; post compensating allocation under approved rule
cases.persistentAssertions: Original ledger immutable, reversal separately recorded; balances consistent
cases.sideEffectAssertions: Appropriate adjustment event, not duplicate original payment
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Customer sees accurate corrected status after verified event

cases.title: Tenant suspension blocks POD for active cargo
cases.given: Trip STARTED, customer cargo in custody, subscription suspended
cases.when: Assigned driver/recipient records mandatory handover/POD under continuity contract
cases.then: Do not strand active safety evidence; allow exactly scoped approved continuity
cases.persistentAssertions: Evidence stored and auditable; no new discretionary booking
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Safety action available subject to approved scoped policy

cases.title: SaaS outage opens global unrestricted fallback
cases.given: Billing or policy service unreachable; driver task ongoing
cases.when: Call safety API with absent tenant context or forged trip ID
cases.then: DENY cross-tenant, do not enable blanket fallback; only previously approved safety scope
cases.persistentAssertions: No foreign custody/POD writes
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Service unavailable or narrow authorized continuation

cases.title: Suspended tenant sends fresh booking through safe-continuity token
cases.given: Tenant has active trip continuity grant only and subscription suspended
cases.when: Call create new Booking using continuity credential
cases.then: DENY new commercial action; safety grant cannot expand
cases.persistentAssertions: No new Booking/reservation
cases.userVisibleOutcome: New order action disabled, active cargo remains visible

cases.title: External membership revoke takes effect only in UI
cases.given: Grant revoked in DB but old JWT, WS subscription and cached response remain
cases.when: Call HTTP, stream and async export after commit
cases.then: DENY all newly authorized data operations; close/re-authorize stream and export
cases.persistentAssertions: No new read/export granted by stale token
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No protected stream event or export delivery
cases.userVisibleOutcome: UI shows revoked status; not stale data

cases.title: Outbox dispatch duplicates business side effect
cases.given: DB transaction committed and Outbox message delivered, acknowledgement lost
cases.when: Retry same message concurrently on two workers
cases.then: At-least-once transport, exactly one logical domain effect via inbox uniqueness
cases.persistentAssertions: No duplicate Booking, invoice, custody or review row
cases.sideEffectAssertions: Duplicate delivery acknowledged/dedup; not repeated notification side effect
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Only one completed operation is visible; no duplicate notifications or ledger entries

cases.title: Job retries after original actor privilege is revoked
cases.given: Manual delegated job queued under active role, role revoked before execution
cases.when: Use saved JWT/role snapshot to execute privileged operation
cases.then: DENY unauthorized new action; service principal only within explicit scoped job contract
cases.persistentAssertions: Business aggregate unchanged, audit of revoked job attempt
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Job marked denied/escalated; no silent success

cases.title: Support logs reveal cargo PII in failed job exception
cases.given: Failed job payload contains customer contact, driver location and finance data
cases.when: Inspect job metadata/log trace under support operator
cases.then: Redact protected fields, deny raw payload access
cases.persistentAssertions: No unredacted payload in query/export/log for support audience
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No raw replay/log artifact attached to support output
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Only redacted reason code and correlation ID

cases.title: Stale read model projects successful booking after compensation
cases.given: Booking confirmation failed/rolled back but old event arrives late
cases.when: Update customer My Orders from stale/replayed event
cases.then: Do not show authoritative CONFIRMED unless current valid Booking version; order events with version watermark
cases.persistentAssertions: Canonical Booking remains pending/exception and projection eventual state converges
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No customer booking success notification from invalid stale event
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Pending/exception with freshness, not false confirmed

cases.title: Customer cancellation request used as immediate cancel command
cases.given: Booking.CONFIRMED and driver/cargo assignment still active
cases.when: Customer posts cancellation request with cancel=true and fee=0 overposted
cases.then: Only request recorded; server derives terms/fees, Booking unchanged
cases.persistentAssertions: No released capacity, no mutating fee from user-controlled field
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No BookingCancelled event from customer command
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Requested; awaiting decision

cases.title: Cancellation wins while Trip.STARTED update commits
cases.given: Authorized cancellation and Trip.STARTED race on same Booking
cases.when: Commit actions concurrently with stale versions
cases.then: One coherent contract/custody branch; cannot free vehicle with active cargo
cases.persistentAssertions: Either valid pre-start cancellation or execution exception; never both
cases.sideEffectAssertions: No contradictory Cancelled and InExecution customer events
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Single consistent status; exceptions displayed

cases.title: Complaint incorrectly changes POD or grants refund
cases.given: Service partial POD or undelivered with customer damage report
cases.when: Submit customer complaint with requested amount and altered POD fields
cases.then: Create scoped claim record only; no automatic evidence mutation/refund
cases.persistentAssertions: POD immutable; money unchanged; claim linked to service
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Complaint accepted for review independently of feedback

cases.title: Provider staff submits rating for own company
cases.given: Provider employee has Sales permission and can see customer records
cases.when: Submit private review as customer using forged customerAccountId
cases.then: DENY; only verified customer feedback capability on eligible completed service
cases.persistentAssertions: No review or public rating created
cases.userVisibleOutcome: Review submission denied; existing original untouched

scopeOverlay.rules: Historical payment and accounting cases are retired rather than deferred to R1/R2. Case IDs kept to retain audit lineage. Six new PAY-ABS negative cases are current product tests.
